      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withNumWorkers(int n)

    • withClusterUrl

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withClusterUrl(String url)
      Dashboard URL of an existing Ray cluster (e.g. "http://10.0.0.1:8265") When set, no nodes are started and the cluster is never stopped on shutdown; we just submit the job to it 
       new DUUIRayDriver.Component("/home/user/my_component", "server.py")
     .withClusterUrl("http://10.0.0.1:8265")
     .withTaskUrl("http://10.0.0.1:25590")
     .build()

    • withKeepAlive

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withKeepAlive(boolean keepAlive)
      Keep the cluster running after shutdown (default: false). Only matters for driver started clusters. External ones are never stopped!

    • withKeepJobAlive

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withKeepJobAlive(boolean keepJobAlive)
      Keep the Ray job alive when the component is destroyed (default: false)

      Warning: the FastAPI process and its ports (e.g. 25590) stay open until Python exits or you run ray stop manually. This will cause port conflicts if you start the pipeline again

    • withDeleteJob

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withDeleteJob(boolean delete)
      Stop and delete the job from the dashboard once finished (default: false) Overrides withKeepJobAlive(boolean); stop and delete always run when this is set

    • withStreamMode

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withStreamMode(boolean streamMode)
      Enable stream mode: every document's CAS is serialized and sent to /v1/stream, the CAS is left unchanged, and only after all N documents are streamed does the driver call /v1/finalize and write the Ray job result into the last CAS

      Stream mode requires a known document count. Either set it explicitly via withTotalDocuments(long), or use a collection reader that reports getSize() (e.g. DUUIFileReader)

    • withTotalDocuments

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withTotalDocuments(long n)
      Total number of documents to stream. Required when stream mode is enabled and the collection reader does not report a document count via getSize() If the reader reports a size, this value takes priority

    • withCreateOwnCas

      public DUUIRayDriver.Component withCreateOwnCas(boolean createOwnCas)
      When enabled, the finalize result is written into a freshly created JCas instead of the last document CAS received from the reader. The last document CAS is left unchanged. Retrieve the result CAS via DUUIRayDriver.getResultCas(String). Only meaningful when combined with withStreamMode(boolean)

    • withCreateOwnCas
